title: URN namespace inconsistency: capability vs role
description: The capability uses urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:filenode (IETF-style) but the role uses urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space (non-IETF-style). These are in different namespaces with no explanation. If intentional (following a JMAP convention), add a note. If not, pick one consistently across both.
